# Vedantu

> India's leading online and offline learning platform offering live classes, NCERT solutions, and coaching for CBSE, ICSE, JEE, NEET, and Foundation courses.

Vedantu provides comprehensive educational resources including one-to-one tutoring, interactive live classes, NCERT chapter solutions with free PDFs, and offline coaching centres across major Indian cities. The platform specializes in competitive exam preparation (IIT-JEE, NEET UG) alongside school curriculum support from Class 4 to Class 12.

## Key Topics

- NCERT Solutions
- JEE Coaching
- NEET Preparation
- CBSE Curriculum
- IIT-JEE
- Foundation Courses
- Class 10 Maths
- Interactive Live Classes
- Offline Coaching Centres
- Test Preparation
- Study Material
- Entrance Exam Preparation
- One-to-One Tutoring
- NEET UG
- Tatva Books
